nom: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Toner

avis.texte: I love this toner so much! It makes my face feel so clean and fresh!

I absolutely love the Round Lab Birch Toner. From the moment I apply it, my skin feels instantly refreshed and hydrated. The lightweight, watery texture absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky residue, making it perfect for layering with other skincare products. It has a subtle, clean scent that feels calming and not overpowering at all. What I really appreciate is how it soothes and calms my skin, especially when it's feeling dry or irritated. My face feels plump, smooth, and visibly more moisturized after each use. It's become a staple in my morning and evening routines—gentle, effective, and truly nourishing. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a hydrating and refreshing toner!

I have only been used by this product for a month, but I absolutely love it. I used the dodko toner for a long time and I was nervous to try the Birch line because of my sensitive skin but it turned out great. I really enjoy how hydrated my skin feels.
I can truly tell a difference in my skin since using this product!

Round Lab has done it again! This might as well be one of my skincare favs. The Birch Juice toner has a light citrus scent and the consistency of water. I find it to be lightweight and it provides my skin with hydration and moisture. However, it is quite sticky, but that's no problem for me! There are quite a few hydrating ingredients in this product, along with an antioxidant (Ascorbic Acid) and hydrating ceramides (Ceramide Ns). Not only did this product keep my skin hydrated, it brightened my skin as well. Similar to Round Lab's 1025 Dokdo toner, my skin drank up this one as well! I use it both in the mornings and evenings. Birch Juice is my second toner after the 1025 Dokdo toner. I wait 15 minutes for the toners to absorb into my skin, and then I spray some water on my face. After that, I'm all set for the next steps of my skincare routine!
If you have acne and sensitive skin get it. I promise you won't regret. It helped calm my acne and hydrated my skin after using half of it
Lovely moisturizing toner. Not watery. Absolutely love it for all seasons.

At first, I wasn't very impressed. I think it was because I was applying it with a cotton pad on my face. It didn't feel like anything special. However, when I poured the toner onto my hands and patted it into my skin, it felt much better. My skin felt moisturized and hydrated. Currently, I'm using an exfoliating toner with cotton and then applying this toner for hydration, and it works great!
You put it on and it feels wonderful, leaving your skin super juicy.
Very hydrating and the bottle lasts very long. would definately recommend

I have tried several products from the brand and now it was this one's turn. It leaves my skin which is dry and sensitive very hydrated. It didn't irritate me or anything and maybe I would use it better than the Dokdo line, which I also like, but I don't feel like it hydrates me as much as this one.
I love the whole birch juice line, this toner is also really nice but didn't knock me off my feet that much. Nothing negative just a lil underwhelming. Very moisturizing tho.
This toner has changed my life it maintains my skin hydrated. It lasts me a sufficient amount of time. it look me 2 and months to finish it and I can just say that this toner is worth every penny

Flawless oh my gosh. This has truly completed a routine I didn't know was missing anything. After I use my mugwort cleanser, this toner really just sets that moisture in, which I need with my excezma-prone skin. Thank you Round Lab for such phenomenal products.
Super moisturizing, my skin is oily but it suits it super well because it is very light but very moisturizing

Overall, this toner is very inoffensive and works exactly as I hoped it would. I also feel that the size makes it quite economical, so I'm pretty pleased with it. I would say that the hydration I get from this is not particularly special and it's not exactly a stand out product, but it doesn't irritate my skin like most other toners and is more affordable. If you're not one who cares to follow what's trending much and prefer economical options, I suggest trying this out.
Love this esence. It is highly hydrating my skin and preparing it to apply more products afterwards. I've been using it for a week only and I can tell the difference!
This and the 1025 Dokdo Toner literally saved my skin. I have dehydrated skin, and weirdly, it's very easy for it to be overhydrated, but I don't have that issue with this toner.
Very good product, hydrates the skin well. The texture is barely thicker than water and the product is absorbed very quickly by the skin. I recommend

avis.titre: Like a glass of water for my skin
avis.texte: I have been using this for a week and I love it! It is super lightweight and absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving a film. It leaves my skin feeling so hydrated and supple! 3-4 drops are enough for my face and neck, so this will last quite a while - which is good, considering the price. I don't have any complaints.

The Round Lab Birch Juice Moisturizing Toner is a great option for those with normal, combination, or even sensitive skin who want a simple, hydrating toner. It provides a good base for further skincare products and leaves the skin feeling refreshed and comfortable. However, if you have very dry skin or are looking for a toner with additional benefits, you might want to consider a different product.
Love using this toner in the summer! It's hydrating and light enough that it doesn't make my skin too glossy!

So hydrating! The texture is like thick water, but not too thick. I apply two layers in the morning/night and it doesn't irritate my skin or eyes, which is great because my old toner made my cheeks and eye area sting a bit.
Favorite toner. This is not the first and not the last time I take it. Odorless, quickly absorbed, leaving me well hydrated. In hot weather I only use toner, and that's enough.

Absolutely love this brand. This product works wonders for your skin. Once you go K Beauty you never go back. You will not be dissatisfied with this and compared to other competing brands with similar products you can't be disappointed with the price point. This site has the best deals. If you're considering buying this, let this review be the deciding factor for you to purchase!
My daughter brought me samples from her visit to japan and South Korea. Love the birch line because it truly is fragrance free and has made my skin look awesome in just a matter of weeks.

Great toner. Got this for my boyfriend who has very dry skin, and he seems to be loving it. His skin was dry to a point where it would get flakey in spots, but this product hasn't irritated his skin more, and seems to be helping. A nice step before his moisturizer. I got all products from ROUND LAB ROUND that incorporated 'moisturizing' in it's name. Skin has improved a lot.
A nice toner based on birch juice. I love this brand and always a guarantee

The consistency of the toner is like an extremely thin gel, almost like water. It hydrates well and is not irritating. I would describe it as a good everyday toner that you can use if you are not expecting any special effects. I think I will buy it again.
I may love this toner more than the hyaluronic acid Hada Labo one. It is so hydrating. I love this birch line.
For so much toner it costs like a "normal" sized toner. It goes on easily and leaves the skin hydrated. On the app OnSkin it has shoes that it's safe. And it's odorless which I love. 10/10
The cap broke but the seal wasn't broken. My sisters and I love the product itself it is an amazing toner!

I got it because I heard a lot of good things. I didn't think much of a hype product. But this toner is so good! It hydrates very well. This toner is a little thicker but makes it easier to apply. I have sensitive dry acne prone skin and this toner is my new favorite!

This toner is surprisingly perfect. The consistency is thicker, the ingredient list is short and has nothing in it that would irritate my skin and it's really hydrating. The price on sale is ok for the amount you get and per 100ml it's cheaper than many other toners.
I love how light-weight it feels and I definitely see a difference in my skin !
bought this and the matching cleanser and my skin's redness has decreased so much as well as the duration of my acne! only been using for two weeks. i can't wait to see more improvement
Hydrating and the bottle lasts very long. wld recommend ( i have combination skin)
Lightweight fast hydration! Works best when I apply immediately after washing my face on still-slightly-damp skin, and is the perfect prep step before serum and moisturizer

I've only gotten to use it for about a week. And it's been going well. It's very moisturizing and seems to help with my dull skin. Really love the texture of the toner, it's almost feels like a serum.
This definitely felt hydrating and easy to layer with. Feels great and would love to purchase again!
I plan on repurchasing because it's just as good as the BOJ but with nicer aesthetic packaging LOL
Not bad. I like it because it doesn't have a big effect on my skin as a toner. Just normal but good moisturing toner to wipe out my skin after cleansing.

This is very refreshing for hot humid weather. Its watery consistency makes it ideal for morning use. I love using this and go straight to sunscreen. I do this as I love in hot humid weather and it works great
Good for dehydrated skin and it's great for layering. It doesn't leave an oily film on skin which is very nice
It really nice. I am oil skin but it is ok to use this! Another thing i want to mention is that it's very moisturizing and adds nothing bad ingredient. So that's why i really like it so much!
Thicker than a normal toner but absorbs nicely and is hydrating!

avis.titre: If you have a dry skin, use this toner
avis.texte: If you have a dry skin, use this toner before you put lotion. It almost feel like serum.

Really like the viscosity texture of it, looks watery, but when I apply it just glide on my face and my skin like it so much. (similar to the Tiam vita b5 toner) My face has a better complexion. I like the minimal ingredients and packaging, comes in a big bottle, does it's job.

avis.titre: Hydrating and plumping toner with the perfect consistency!
avis.texte: I am loving this toner from Round Lab! It's packed with birch sap, as well as hyaluronic acid and panthenol. The consistency is slightly thicker than water and not sticky at all. The toner is very hydrating and sinks into the skin nicely but is not heavy, which I love so much since my oily-combo skin can't take heavy layers. This is a very versatile toner, meaning you could use it in the warmer or colder months with ease and any skin type could like this. It also did not irritate my super sensitive skin and is alcohol-free and fragrance-free. Definitely a staple in my routine and will be repurchasing!

This skin is probably even better that the mugwort version from the same line.It leaves your skon extremely hydrated - not to mention it works wonders together with the cream from the same line.The best think is it sinks into your skon quite easily - i even layer it for evrn deeper hydration.I would repurchase - I will see - there are so many clean brandsncoming out these day that I cannot resist trying new and new toners still. But this one is really worth to come back to it!

Awesome toner which according to cosdna is loaded with humectants, some vit C and 1% birch sap. I am combining it for the 7 skins with the mugwort toner of the same company and I find the combo more hydrating and refreshing than either toner used on its own,
